Looking at the stacktrace, we see that the error occurs in the `standardize` method of the `ImageDataGenerator`. This method applies various transformations to the input data, including any preprocessing function specified by the user.

The specific error is caused by trying to apply a preprocessing function to an image. However, this function seems to be modifying the shape of the image instead of just resizing it, which causes an error when trying to normalize the image.

After analyzing the code and the stacktrace, I believe that the issue lies in how we are handling the preprocessing function. We need to make sure that the function is only applying transformations that preserve the original dimensions of the images.
